title: How Sigma Manages the Semantic Layer with dbt and Dagster
abstract: Sigma's internal data platform team manages every semantic asset—Snowflake semantic views, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search Services, and Sigma Data Models—inside a single dbt project. In this session, we'll walk through the Dagster job that continuously deploys these assets whenever they change: building modified dbt nodes, persisting dbt state, updating the Sigma connection, and refreshing Sigma Data Models. We'll also preview an open-source contribution to OSI/Ossie: a Sigma converter that lets any team convert between semantic formats within a Dagster job, making it easier to adopt a unified, orchestrated semantic layer across tools.

title: Self-Healing Semantic Layers with Snowflake Cortex AI
abstract: An inside look at J.A.K.E. (Just Another Knowledge Engine), a production-grade Cortex AI agent embedded in Slack and Sigma that self-heals semantic layers — automatically generating Snowflake semantic views from dbt metadata, capturing query failures, identifying root causes, and patching definitions to create a continuous AgenticOps learning loop.

title: Self-Healing Semantic Layers with Snowflake Cortex AI: How Sigma Built J.A.K.E.
abstract: How Sigma built J.A.K.E., a production Cortex AI agent embedded in Slack and Sigma that self-heals semantic layers by automatically generating Snowflake semantic views from dbt metadata, debugging query failures in real time, and patching definitions to create a continuous learning loop.
